source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Identifying Business Opportunities (PDF 131-132, printed 127-128).

blocks.text: Business ke mauqe pehchanne ka matlab hai muashre ke aise masle dhoondna jo products ya services se hal ho sakein. Entrepreneurs customers ki zarooratein aur market ki demand samajhne ke liye rozmarra zindagi ko ghaur se dekhte hain. Technology naye mauqe dhoondne mein madad deti hai, jaise online taleem, e-commerce aur digital services. Kamyab entrepreneurs asal zindagi ke masle naye tareeqon se hal karne par focus karte hain. Pakistan mein zaraat (agriculture), sehat (healthcare) aur taleem jaise shobe digital business ke khayalat ke liye bohat mauqe dete hain.

blocks.alt: Darakht numa khaaka (tree diagram). Upar ka dabba Technology-Based Solutions teeron se chaar dabbon tak jata hai: Education (E-learning), Healthcare (Telemedicine), Agriculture (Smart farming) aur Business (Digital payments).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4: Technology par mabni hal (technology-based solutions) (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein Business ka dabba Healthcare ke neeche latka hai aur teer Healthcare se Business ki taraf hai, jaise karobar sehat ka hissa ho. Kitab ka apna matn chaar alag shobe batata hai: taleem, sehat, zaraat (agriculture) aur karobar. Is liye yahan Business ko baqi teen ki tarah seedha upar wale dabbe ki chauthi shaakh banaya gaya hai. Har shobe ke saath bracket mein us ki technology ki misal hai.

blocks.prompt: Business opportunity pehchanne ka kya matlab hai? Pakistan ke teen shobe batayein jahan digital mauqe hain.
blocks.explanation: Muashre ke aise masle dhoondna jo products ya services se hal ho sakein. Shobe: zaraat (agriculture), sehat (healthcare) aur taleem (education).

items: Business opportunity: masla dhoondo, product ya service se hal karo.
Technology naye mauqe deti hai: online education, e-commerce, digital services.
